title: results.json — Campus AI OS back socket, envelope v1.1
description: ONE envelope for every emitter (Campus AI OS 5.2.0 Phase 3.1, merged plan D1). v1.1 = the Interop v1 asset ledger (`assets[]`, kernel readers unchanged) PLUS a required run-level `completion` (what mint-run-id has always written) PLUS optional `bindings[]` (who ran each stage, R2). This file is the canonical home; library/teams/_foundry/schemas/results.schema.json is a byte-identical copy enforced by the kernel fixtures. WRITE side: every field here, `schema_version` "1.1". READ side: tools/validate_results.py accepts 1.0 / missing / "1.1-completion-only" documents as legacy and never fails a reader on them (Interop spec §6; Codex critique 2026-09-05 #2).

schema_version.$comment: Envelope version only. The emitter PROFILE goes in `profile`; never smuggle a profile name into this field (the 1.1-completion-only lesson, Foundry CANON Break 5).

profile.$comment: completion-only = saleable teams: assets carry external_ref + completion and omit performance. full = owner-side emitters that may attach performance.

run_id.$comment: Minted by tools/mint_run_id.py: {slug}-{YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSfff}[-xxxx]. The 6-digit form is accepted so teams still minting inline (scaffold-team text, until item 3.5) validate. Never invented by the model.

team.$comment: The emitting team's registry `team` id. Playbook runs write the owning kernel team (campus-ai-os) and name the playbook in `playbook`.

generated_at.$comment: ISO 8601 with a zone. UTC `Z` preferred.

external_ref.$comment: Run-level re-findable handle in the owner's systems (order id, post id, ticket…) or null. Any JSON type; the reader treats it as opaque.

completion.$comment: Run-level self-report, exactly three booleans (Foundry v1.1 spec 5.2). Relation to assets: execution_success = the run finished; artifact_passed = every asset passed its own done-check; owner_approved = the owner said yes. An asset-level `completion` never overrides these.

assets.$comment: Interop v1 §3.1 asset ledger, unchanged for existing readers. May be empty (a run that produced nothing still reports completion). `skipped`/`failed` added in 1.1 because live ledgers already use them. `performance` is capability-gated and optional; absent is not failure.

bindings.$comment: R2 pull-forward (recipes-are-the-moat): who ran each stage, at what version, why, what else could have, and what came of it. Optional in 5.2.0; the Phase 3.4 producer→consumer fixture carries one; 5.3.0 dynamic staffing makes the resolver write it on every run.

outcome.$comment: Run-level observed outcome once known (sales, replies, attendance…). Opaque to the envelope; outcome-reporter interprets it.
